text: Rachel - 20wks scan Thurs, all fine. finding out sex @ next one. she's still v sick in the mornings
Kofi (mgr) leaving end of the month - moving to Leeds office. collection going round, chip in by Fri
dry cleaning / pharmacy / bin bags. pick up suit Sat morning
Uma pregnant!! due early March. told me @ coffee, only 12wks so keep quiet. hubby Cem over the moon
Hadiza's christening for baby Ife - Sun 2nd, St Mary's 11am, lunch afterwards @ hers. need to get a card + something silver

call w/ Carmen re Okafor account - client wants revised quote sometime next week. she's stressed, boss breathing down her neck - Hadiza said Ife's godparents are her brother Yosef and an old uni friend. her mother-in-law is doing all the food, apparently a whole goat lol. dress code smart, no white. ask Hadiza the day before if she needs help setting up chairs

Aoife had the baby! girl, 7lb 2, born Tues night. both doing well. send flowers to the house a week after once they're settled. second time this quarter they've moved the goalposts. Mr Okafor wants it itemised by dept now. Carmen thinks Helen in finance can pull the numbers but she's off till Weds. I said I'd look over the draft Thurs before it goes
dentist moved to Weds 3pm. car MOT end of month - book it
Dalia - new role @ Banerjee & Co starts Mon. nervous abt the commute. text her that morning
Kavya's sister Lena expecting twins over the summer. Kavya going to be auntie x2, v excited
Nadia back from mat leave on the 14th. phased return, 3 days/wk. baby Theo at nursery now - she's finding drop offs hard
Lucy & Lin - housewarming Sat. bringing wine. they've got a new kitten, Pickle
Marta = new hire on Ryan's team. ex-Deloitte, vegan, does triathlons. sitting next to me from Mon

Adriana's baby shower cancelled - she's on bed rest. ring her sometime next week, see how she's doing. she says the baby's lying awkwardly and the consultant wants her resting till 36wks at least. her husband Bogdan is doing everything, her mum's on the way from Valencia. sounded fed up and bored more than anything
Bogdan Popescu (client, Romania) - visiting HQ early Nov. wants dinner the night he lands. book somewhere w/o fish, he hates seafood
renew passport!! expires Jan. photos from Boots
Jess - perf review Thurs, worried abt it after the restructure. ask how it went the next day

Meera & Joseph - baby boy, Arjun, arrived Sun. Joseph off on paternity for 2wks. drop round a lasagne end of the week. also he's taking Meera's parents to the airport the morning of, so I'm doing the hospital run for her mum if needed. Meera loves anything with paneer, no mushrooms
Ayo said his wife is pregnant again, due around Easter. their eldest starts reception in Sept too. busy yr for them
Helen (finance) retiring - do is Fri 28th @ Red Lion. leaving card on my desk, sign + pass to Naledi
Naledi - glucose test Mon, gestational diabetes risk. bit anxious. check in afterwards
Yosef's wife Rebecca had a c-section last wk, recovery slow. he's working from home for a bit. don't forget to ask after her
Delroy promoted to team lead!! announced @ standup. congrats msg + drinks sometime next week?

Eilidh - flat viewing Sat for bigger place, baby due Feb so need the 2nd bed. hope it works out - she's 6 months gone and the current flat is a one bed above a chippy. landlord won't do anything abt the mould. if this one falls through she's going to her parents in Dundee for the birth, which she really doesn't want
gym - cancel membership before the 1st or charged again
Damian - client pitch Tues to Lopez Group. he's done the deck, v nervous. text good luck the day before, then call afterwards to hear how it went
Ravi's wife Adaeze 34wks. he's on call all next wk in case. covering his Thurs meeting
Hadiza - Ife's christening went lovely, she sent pics. thank-you card arrived. Ife already crawling??
Uma - morning sickness bad, off sick Mon/Tues. her mum staying to help. msg her, nothing work related

Ryan (my mgr) - 1:1 moved to Fri. wants my Q4 plan by then. also his daughter Mia graduates Nov - he's flying to Glasgow for it. need to have the Q4 plan done Thurs latest so he can look before. and get a card for Mia's graduation, something Scottish, he said she's mad about Highland cows
batteries, birthday card for Grandad, stamps. post office before 5
Carmen - Okafor deal signed!! she's buzzing. her boss finally off her case. lunch on me sometime next week
Lena - 2nd scan end of month. twins both measuring fine so far. Kavya says she's dropping hints abt a double buggy
Rachel's partner Kofi - not my mgr Kofi, the other one - turns 40 sat. she's planning surprise drinks, keep schtum. bring a bottle
Cem - paternity leave starting March. he's handing over the Singh project to Marta before. need to sit in on handover, wk before he goes
Joseph - Arjun's naming ceremony early Dec. at his parents' in Croydon. Meera asked me to be a guardian!! ring her back tonight to say yes

Aoife's mum flying in from Cork the day after the birth, staying till Christmas. Aoife v grateful but a bit overwhelmed tbh. Joseph's brother Delroy flying in from Toronto for it, staying 2 wks. Meera wants the guardians to do a short reading - apparently I need to pick one. ask her for options sometime next week
Lin's dog Biscuit got out again, found 2 streets away. Lucy furious. lol
Adriana Lopez - consultant appt Weds re bed rest. Bogdan (her partner, not the client) driving her. scan the day before was ok-ish. text Weds evening, see what they said
Q4 planning offsite - 6th-7th Nov, Bristol. train booked. hotel still to sort
Marta's partner Eilidh?? didn't know. small world. they're trying for a baby - don't mention
Delroy's first team meeting as lead Mon morning. said he'd been dreading it. send a quick msg that morning, keep it light
Dalia - 1st wk @ Banerjee went ok. likes her manager Ravi Banerjee (owner's son). commute still awful, thinking of moving closer over the summer
Rebecca back on her feet, Yosef back in office Mon. they're doing a small blessing for the baby end of the month, family only
Jess - review went fine, actually got a raise. relief. she's taking her kids to Tenerife half term to celebrate
Naledi - test came back clear!! no GD. due date still 3 Jan. bump enormous now. she's craving pickled onions
boiler service Thurs 8-12 - WFH. move standup
Helen's leaving do - great night. she's off to Portugal in Jan for 3 months w/ her husband. her daughter Kavya (diff Kavya) took over her desk
Kofi from finance - wife expecting, due late spring. found out today. first one, he looked terrified. congrats card from team?
Ayo's mum in hospital again, hip. he's flying to Lagos sometime next week, unclear for how long. tell Ryan I'll cover his clients
Nadia - Theo's christening Sun 16th, 2pm, her parents' church. reception after @ the cricket club. she's asked us to bring a dish. I'm doing the samosas
Lucy's pregnant!!! 8wks. Lin cried telling me lol. they're telling family @ Christmas. due mid July. remind me to get them a little something after the 12wk scan, early Dec
Damian - pitch went badly, Lopez went w/ another agency. he's gutted, blaming himself. Rachel says the boss isn't fussed. take him for a pint Fri, don't talk shop

call w/ Okafor client (Mr Okafor) - wants all invoices consolidated monthly from Jan. tell Carmen + Helen's replacement. Rachel was there too, said he's been up till 2am every night prepping. I think he needs a break, his wife says he's barely slept since the restructure
Meera - says Arjun not sleeping, she's exhausted, Joseph back at work Mon. her sister Adaeze coming to help over half term. drop off food the day before Joseph goes back
long day. nothing much. pay credit card, order more coffee pods, sort recycling

Kavya - Lena's twins came early!! 33wks, both in NICU but stable. Lena's partner Cem (Kavya's cousin, not work Cem) sleeping at hospital. Kavya flying up to Edinburgh Thurs to help, back the following Mon. Asked me to water her plants and feed her cat Mango while away - keys under the pot. check in w/ her midweek, she sounded wrecked. also maybe a hamper for Lena once they're home, end of next month-ish

Eilidh - viewing was a no, damp everywhere. 2nd viewing Tues eve, 3 bed nr the park. she's 32wks so time's running out, getting v stressed abt it. Marta's helping with the search. msg Weds to see if it's any good
Ryan - quarterly review w/ client Banerjee Fri. he wants me to present the numbers. prep slides Thurs, run through w/ him that afternoon. drinks w/ team afterwards apparently
Uma - 12wk scan pics!! told the team today. Cem took the afternoon off. she's past the worst of the sickness. due 4 March. her baby shower prob early Feb, her sister Jess organising
